search_hint: build a staged learning path from a competency model and a baseline assessment

model_ref.description: Opaque artifact:// reference for a CareerCompetencyModel. Omit to resolve the most recent matching Action result in context.

baseline_ref.description: Opaque artifact:// reference for a BaselineAssessment. Omit to resolve the most recent matching Action result in context.

goal_level.description: User's personal goal on the depth ladder: working, independent, or advanced. Omit or pass null for market-aligned (the model's expected_depth per competency). Only pass a value the user actually stated; ask via AskUserQuestion before calling when it is unknown and would materially change the plan's scope.

constraints.description: User-stated planning constraints: available_time_per_week (required string) and deadline (required string or null; null only when the user explicitly said they have no deadline), plus optional resource_constraints, explicit_goals, and notes. Before calling, ask the user via AskUserQuestion for any missing required values or for other missing inputs that would materially change the plan; batch missing questions into one call. Never invent constraints.
